definitions.explanation: The person or company that sells a product, especially as named on a label, a contract or an online listing. A formal, written word; in conversation people say the shop or the company's name.

examples.japanese: {販売者|はんばいしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{問|と}い{合|あ}わせる→問い合わせる：17737_toiawaseru⟧。
⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ラベル→ラベル：00348_raberu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{販売者|はんばいしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{住所|じゅうしょ}→住所：01430_juusho⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{書|か}いてある→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: The seller's address is printed on the product label.

examples.japanese: ⟦ネット→ネット：05279_netto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}かない→届く：00899_todoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{販売者|はんばいしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{返金|へんきん}→返金：06130_henkin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}めた→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: The item I bought online never arrived, so I asked the seller for a refund.

notes:
Made of ⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧ (sales) + 〜⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person). On Japanese food labels, {販売者|はんばいしゃ} names the company that sells the product, beside {製造者|せいぞうしゃ} (the manufacturer).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{売|う}り{手|て}→売り手：24769_urite⟧: seller (in a deal, as opposed to the buyer)
- ⟦{販売店|はんばいてん}→販売店：20898_hanbaiten⟧: dealer, retail shop
- ⟦{購入者|こうにゅうしゃ}→購入者：25442_kounyuusha⟧: buyer, purchaser
